product_media_source_check.name: product_media_source_check
product_media_source_check.value:
("product_media"."kind" = 'video_link' AND "product_media"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "product_media"."storage_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("product_media"."kind" IN ('image', 'document') AND "product_media"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "product_media"."url" IS NULL)

llm_connections_budget_check.name: llm_connections_budget_check
llm_connections_budget_check.value: "llm_connections"."monthly_budget_minor" IS NULL OR ("llm_connections"."monthly_budget_minor" >= 0 AND "llm_connections"."budget_currency" IS NOT NULL)

payments_succeeded_verified_check.name: payments_succeeded_verified_check
payments_succeeded_verified_check.value: "payments"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR ("payments"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)
